definition: Not primary research, a methods paper or a data paper (review, editorial, commentary), or only an abstract is available. Reviews are kept for citation chasing.

Area out of scope: meets none of (a) inside the CAVM extent, (b) tundra or forest-tundra north of 60°N, (c) tundra or a permafrost landform in a permafrost zone (Obu et al. 2019) north of 50°N. Includes sites south of 50°N, Antarctica and planetary analogues.
Surface is not land: glacier, ice sheet, sea ice, snow surface only, or seabed.
No elevation data used (e.g., microforms mapped from imagery alone).
All elevation data coarser than 5 m native resolution, or point clouds with nominal spacing above 5 m.
No terrain variable computed and no microform delineated from the 5 m-or-finer data (e.g., raw elevation or elevation change only).
Secondary report of an included study (linked as a companion).
Full text unobtainable after the retrieval procedure.
Full text in a language that could not be translated.
